description: Cross-driver idle word-reset vectors (PAR-2): whether the pause before a keystroke starts a new word. Replayed by the Windows rule (HSE_IdleResetsWord) and by the shared Lua rule (hotstring_engine.idle_resets_word) that macOS and Linux both call. The clock is exact (resolution 0) on every driver that replays these.

field_semantics.last_ms: Monotonic time of the previous keystroke in milliseconds, null before any keystroke.
field_semantics.now_ms: Monotonic time of the current keystroke in milliseconds.
field_semantics.resets: Whether the pause starts a new word.

vectors.description: A gap exactly equal to the delay resets (the comparison is greater-or-equal).
One millisecond below the delay keeps the word.
A pause far beyond the delay resets.
A delay of 0 disables the idle reset whatever the pause.
Before any keystroke there is nothing to be idle since.
A fractional delay is compared in whole milliseconds: 500 ms of a 0.5 s delay resets.
499 ms of a 0.5 s delay keeps the word.
